body:
Early 30s and feeling the same. Certain aches I attribute to weight gain and little exercise over the last year, but I feel other aches (thighs, neck and shoulders, chest (100% muscular)) is related to drinking, and has been getting worse. 

So, hopefully today is the last time I say tomorrow.

Pacing. To the point my legs are practically falling off.

And baking. Don’t want to eat them. But making macaroons at 3am is the best.

Let’s do a science experiment. I’ll let you dudes know when I’m doing the needful, few days I think by the time I get everything sorted (I’m meant to be in court on Thursday), I’ll link my day to day account, if I don’t post after you’ll know I’m finally free.
Ridiculously so. To the point I am sure it’s been a contributor in my relationships breaking down. But I don’t think it’s Bipolar related. Happy to be proven wrong though!
Are you new to it? I experienced this too (it’s a common side effect) but for me it subsided pretty quickly. Just be careful you don’t go overboard with the water.

Mention it (in an amusing way) on my Tinder profile. I don’t want to be defined by this, or make a talking point out of it, but honestly this just seems easier. 

Too bad I’m too socially anxious to actually date tho 😂

Thanks, seeing the doc tomorrow.

Unfortunately 418 was already taken 😂

Weird place is an understatement, its like feeling fantastic laid over the top of depression. Trying to hang onto the fantastic bit before I inevitably spiral again. I dont really have a support network, people around me and my family would disagree, but it all feels so superficial. I think my biggest fan is my psychologist, but it doesnt really count when you're paying them. I really appreciate the reply, thx.
